title: Azure Platform Engineer || Offshore
description:
Azure Platform Skills 
 Strong hands-on experience with Azure PaaS services.

 Experience with Azure App Service, Azure SQL, Blob Storage, Key Vault, Service Bus, Application Insights, and Log Analytics.

 Good understanding of cloud networking, identity, security, monitoring, and scalability.

 
 DevOps Skills 
 Strong experience with Azure DevOps pipelines.

 Experience in CI/CD automation, release management, deployment approvals, and rollback strategies.

 Knowledge of Git, branching strategy, artifact management, and pipeline governance.

 
 Infrastructure as Code 
 Hands-on experience with Bicep, Terraform, ARM templates, or similar tools.

 Ability to automate environment provisioning and configuration.

 Experience managing multiple environments using repeatable deployment templates.

 
 Cloud Security & Operations 
 Experience with Key Vault, Managed Identity, network security, private endpoints, and role-based access.

 Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, and operational dashboards.

 Understanding of cloud cost, performance, resilience, and availability considerations.

 
 Modernization Experience 
 Experience supporting legacy-to-cloud modernization programs.

 Understanding of .NET-based application hosting on Azure.

 Exposure to batch processing, data migration, integration, and platform transformation.

 
 AI & Agile Experience 
 Exposure to AI-assisted DevOps, automation, or platform engineering.

 Ability to work in Agile delivery cycles.

 Experience supporting iterative platform builds across phased modernization waves.
